messages.subject: CPD: Real estate update seminar — 11 March, 12.30pm
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello all,

A reminder that the quarterly Real Estate CPD seminar (Building Safety Act and commercial lease update) is on 11 March at 12.30pm in the 5th floor training room, lunch provided. 1.5 CPD hours. Please reply to me if attending so I can confirm numbers.

Donna
